## Checklist

- [ ] Single-purpose PR (no unrelated refactors)
- [ ] `pnpm lint:fix` and relevant typechecks/tests pass
- [ ] Writes are gated server-side (`withAuth` / `withDemoOrAuth`)
- [ ] No PII, tokens, or raw transaction data in logs, analytics, fixtures, or screenshots
- [ ] Migrations included for schema changes
